Context: Emoluments:

## Emoluments:  
Pay in Pay Matrix at Level 9 = t 82,600 + DA t 37,996 = t 1,20,596  
Death Gratuity admissible in the case of permanent or temporary official who dies while in service after having put in-  
- (a) 33 years or more of service.
- (c) 22 Yi years of service.
- (b) 10 years of service
- (d) 2 years of service.
- (a) Death Gratuity = t 1,20,596 x Yi x 66 = t 39,79,668  
limited to t 20,00,000  
- (b) Death Gratuity= t 1,20,596 x 12 = t 1,44,716
